# Gap junction draws for the paper's 15x15 sheet of pancreatic beta cells.
#
# One draw per connection, in the order `sknm.sheet` numbers them: the 210
# x-direction connections row-major, then the 210 y-direction connections
# row-major. That is the layout the reference implementation writes its own
# `random_picks/gj_scale_15x15_x.txt` and `gj_scale_15x15_y.txt` in, and these
# are those two files concatenated, unchanged.
#
# They are committed, where the equivalent 40x40 cardiac draws are not, because
# the beta figures need them and the cardiac ones do not. On the cardiac sheet
# there are 3120 connections and the conduction path is 25 cells long, so the
# choice of draws moves the velocity by about 2% and any seed reproduces the
# published figure. On this sheet there are 420 connections and the path is 8
# cells, so at gamma = 1 the draws move it by 20% and every seed tried fell below
# the axis of the published Figure S1. No asserted number depends on them --
# every validation target is at gamma = 0, where the draws cancel out of the
# formula entirely -- so this is a figure concern and never a correctness one.
#
# Source: Jaeger & Tveito, Sci Rep 13:16434 (2023), reference implementation,
# CC BY 4.0.
